# core-ferule-engine — LLM Context

> **Purpose:** Provide LLMs with essential context for working on core-ferule-engine

---

## Project Identity

**Name:** core-ferule-engine  
**Version:** v1-core-ferule-engine  
**Role:** Execution engine for Ferule-Core ecosystem  
**Location:** `ferule-core/core-ferule-engine/`

## Architecture

```
core-ferule-engine/
├── run_engine.py              # Python execution engine
├── requirements.txt           # Python dependencies
├── core/
│   ├── rules/                 # Business rules
│   ├── models/                # Data models
│   └── workflows/             # Workflow definitions
├── interfaces/                # External interfaces
├── nexus-protocol/            # Inter-ferule protocol
├── scripts/                   # Utility scripts
├── skill/
│   └── ferule-core/           # Entry point skill
│       └── SKILL.md
└── development/
    └── v1-core-ferule-engine/
        ├── README.md
        ├── USER-NOTES.md
        └── reports/
```

## Normative Compliance

This project conforms to **core-standard V2** structure:
- `BLUEPRINT.md` at root
- `USER-NOTES.md` derived from BLUEPRINT
- `skill/<name>/SKILL.md` for entry point
- `development/v<version>-<app>/` for versioned development
